messages:
chloe: heads up — promo for v2.14.0 is blocked, canary failed in CI. cache-validate step returning 503s and subsequent artifact fetches timing out. release window in ~2h :alarm_clock:

deploy-bot: promo_state=HALTED, last_error="artifact fetch failed (404) after cache-validate 503", retry_count=3

jon: do we have logs from the builder/registry?

chloe: snippet from CI: cache-validate GET https://cache.internal/validate/sha256:abc123 -> 503; fetch-artifact GET https://registry.internal/artifacts/v2.14.0/layer-3.tar.gz -> 404.

maya: 503 from cache typically means proxy or auth rotation. 404 suggests index mismatch or upload never finished. did the upload return 0 but fail to finalize?

sre-oncall: we're seeing elevated 5xx from cache-usw2 since ~10m. ops paged, rotating cache nodes now.

chloe: build logs say upload step exited 0, but checksum in index != uploaded blob checksum. possible race with promotion job updating index entry.

jon: suggestion: manual pin to last-good artifact (v2.13.7) and run canary smoke. cc @release-manager

release-manager: let's hold promo and pin to v2.13.7 for prod. we can manual-promote a verified image to avoid customer impact. will postpone v2.14.0 to next change window if needed.

maya: verified that gs://artifacts/prod/v2.13.7 exists. recommend running smoke locally against pinned artifact before promote.

jon: manual promote steps: 1) open PR to update release pin in infra/rollout/manifest; 2) run `@deploy-bot promote --manifest infra/rollout/manifest#PR --force --reason "canary artifact fetch failures"` after approvals; 3) run `make smoke-canary` (~10m).

deploy-bot: manual promote requires release-manager approval and +1 from eng-release lead. will queue command after PR approvals.

release-manager: approved. jon hold PR until smoke passes and ping me.

sre-oncall: ops ETA to restore cache cluster ~30-45m. intermittent 503s may persist; pinning recommended to unblock customers.

chloe: opening incident for cache cluster + artifact index checksum mismatch.

(10m later)

jon: smoke passed against v2.13.7 canary with no regressions. PR created infra/rollout/manifest#4572.

release-manager: +1 on PR, approving manual promote.

deploy-bot: manual promote initiated by release-manager for infra/rollout/manifest#4572 -> prod. notifying channels.

chloe: updating release notes: v2.14.0 delayed due to artifact-index race and cache outage; will follow up with RCA.

maya: filing infra task: add pre-validate uploads and retry/backoff for cache auth rotation to prevent marking uploads as success when index isn't consistent.

release-manager: decision: postpone v2.14.0 to next change window, mark blocked in tracker, schedule postmortem after incident contains. pinning to v2.13.7 retained to preserve SLA.

jon: closing when deploy-bot confirms rollout healthy.

deploy-bot: promote complete. rollout progressed 25%->100% over 12m without errors. status: SUCCESS.

chloe: prod healthy. filing follow-ups and closing thread.
